name: TexAu
description: TexAu is a go-to-market data platform for enrichment, search, web research, CRM synchronization, outbound automation, tables, workflows, and AI-assisted pipeline operations.
agentUseSummary: Add a customer-owned, action-scoped API key. Agents may run only one approval-gated synchronous email-type classifier through a fixed REST endpoint; Relay returns category flags but never the input address or guessed identity. Raw MCP, the wider action catalog, enrichment, scraping, search, CRM writes, outbound automation, bulk work, async jobs, webhooks, polling, downloads, and exports remain disabled.

capabilities.label: Identify email type
capabilities.description: Classify one exact email address and return only bounded privacy-redacted category flags.

approvalRequired.label: Identify email type
approvalRequired.description: Classify one exact email address with TexAu while returning only privacy-redacted category flags.

blocked.label: Run enrichment or search
blocked.description: Email, phone, person, company, profile, lead, web, social, search, scraping, AI, and waterfall enrichment actions are outside V1.

blocked.label: Run automations
blocked.description: Tables, workflows, schedules, CRM synchronization, outbound sequences, writes, webhooks, and other automations are outside V1.

blocked.label: Expose private results
blocked.description: Input email addresses, usernames, guessed names, provider-returned contact data, execution logs, provider traces, and raw responses are never returned.

blocked.label: Call arbitrary APIs
blocked.description: Raw REST, MCP, CLI, another action, origin, path, method, header, payload, key, or integration is outside V1.

blocked.label: Run bulk or async work
blocked.description: Bulk inputs, automatic pagination, polling, inquiry endpoints, retries, crawling, streaming, uploads, downloads, and exports are outside V1.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Each privacy-sensitive, potentially credit-consuming classification requires matching approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: The selected classifier runs without Relay per-action approval while fixed endpoint, schema, credit, audit, privacy-redaction, and response bounds remain enforced.

runtimeSupport.description: Relay mounts one typed approval-gated classifier and keeps the API key encrypted.

providerSetup.blocker: No customer-owned TexAu API account, dedicated action-scoped key, credit entitlement, or live acceptance evidence is available in this workspace.
providerSetup.nextAction: In the provider-console task create a dedicated key allowlisted only for texau-identify-email-type, store it through Relay, then validate provider pricing, approval/denial, privacy redaction, key rotation, disconnect, and post-disconnect denial with a user-approved test address.

evidence.supports: Official API documentation gives base URL https://v3-api.texau.com/api/v1, x-api-key authentication, action-scoped keys, prepaid credits, sandbox availability, broad REST/MCP capabilities, async jobs, webhooks, and quota behavior.

Official action documentation gives fixed POST /api/v1/texau-identify-email-type, required email input, synchronous mode, output classification fields, rate limits, provider errors, and private per-action pricing.
Official pricing documents prepaid credits, per-call or successful-result charging, private changing per-action costs, separate API/MCP accounts, and customer-owned billing.
